structured.answer: On the home page, tap "להבין סוג של חיסכון" (or "מדריך" in the top menu). That opens a guide with a card for each type of saving, so you just find the one you heard of, like "קרן השתלמות" or "מדד S&P 500", and tap it.

stuck.why: The big form 'מה השאלה שלכם?' with amount fields and the 'מה הכי מתאים' button takes the main spot. The card I needed is in the left column, which I read last, so it looks like a side thing.
Lots of cards that look alike (indexes, bonds, kinds of גמל). I was scrolling without reading and almost lost track of what I was looking for.
The page jumped, so I missed some cards in between, like the top of 'כסף שוטף וקצר'.

used: Card 'להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
Guide heading 'כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה. לכל אחד אותו מבנה'
skimmed: Section headings 'חיסכון עם הטבת מס', 'פרישה', 'לילדים', 'לבחירה עצמית', 'במה הכסף מושקע'
skipped: Form 'מה השאלה שלכם?' and its fields
Footer and the 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי' line
Cards for bonds, מק"מ and pension
not_found: What's actually inside a product card (I didn't see an open card)
A clear 'start here for beginners' pointer on the home page

findings.what: The way in to explaining a type of saving is a side card in the left column. The big form takes the main spot, so a first-time visitor can miss it.
The guide is a long list of many cards that look the same, with no hint of which ones a beginner should read.
Lots of jargon in the card descriptions (מק"מ, צמודה, MSCI AC World, קרן שעוקבת)
findings.where: Guide page, cards under 'במה הכסף מושקע'

findings.what: Some cards appear twice and some product names repeat (מק"מ shows up twice), which is confusing
findings.where: Guide page, 'כסף שוטף וקצר' and 'במה הכסף מושקע'

findings.what: Dark background and small grey text are hard to read on a phone
